Source: service/tools/maven-plugin/src/test/{java,resources}.
The original model-descriptor.zip is copied unchanged; model-descriptor.json and
build-info.json are its complete extracted TEST fixture members. Maven test POM
options and test transport/log fixtures are adapted to native explicit settings.
See compat/provenance.json, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and
compat/licenses/timefold-Apache-2.0.txt for identities, modifications and license.

model-descriptor.hex reversibly encodes the original model-descriptor.zip bytes.
The runtime test fixture decodes those same bytes before upload. Apache-2.0.
